newsitem.title: USA: Pilgrim Baxter closes Select Equity fund.
newsitem.headline: Pilgrim Baxter closes Select Equity fund.

text.p: Pilgrim Baxter & Associates said it would close the PBHG Select Equity Fund to new investors, effective Oct 1.
Harold Baxter, Pilgrim's chairman and chief executive, said the fund was closing to insure "we are managing the pace of growth of assets managed."
The fund's strategy calls for it to invest in only in 25-30 stocks with a strong earnings growth outlook.
The fund, which opened in April 1995, currently has assets of about $600 million.
In April, 1996, the fund had assets of about $200 million, growing about $400 million in six months.
